data_fields.name: ouch_face_ticks

data_fields.name: pain_bands
data_fields.donor_constant: 5 levels from floor((100 - hp) * 5 / 101), hp clamped to 100

best_idea: One pure function per tic turns engine events (hit with bearing, big loss, fire held, immune, dead) into one portrait frame by a priority ladder with timers, so the HUD never reads combat state directly.
decision_why: Keep the priority ladder and its timers as a pure client function fed by engine events (HUD is client-only, row 14); drop the 42 sprite frames for one generic set; fix the inverted OUCH sign so a big hit shows OUCH. The donor's cosmetic-RNG split is kept.
acceptance: At 375 wide in a duel: a 25 hp hit in one tick shows the OUCH frame for 1 s; a 10 hp hit from the left shows turn-left; holding fire for about 2 s shows rampage; a dead hero holds the dead frame until respawn. Unit test feeds recorded snapshot sequences to stepFace and asserts frame names.
